# ANALYSIS: TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO_OOS_ANALYSIS

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** oos_ab_test
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Enabling the call-veto knob will block counter-trend CALL entries on days where bearish structure is confirmed (via 5m-close-through-respected-ascending-support), thereby reducing losses on J's loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07) without affecting the PUT winners (4/29, 5/01, 5/04). The incremental edge capture comes solely from avoiding call losses on loser days.

## Mechanism

The `trendline_break_call_veto` knob (default OFF) reads the `structure-state.json` flag set by `market_structure.py`. When a bearish structure break is detected (5m close below a respected ascending support with ≥2 touches), the engine vetoes any CALL entry signal for the remainder of the trading day. PUT signals are unaffected. The veto is applied in `engine_cli.decide_payload` after routing derivation, gated on the knob.
